Unavailable when a required input is missing. The liquidity amount uses reported cash and separately identifiable unrestricted current investment categories. A complete classified current-asset breakdown can establish a cash-only aggregate without establishing zero for an undisclosed standalone investment balance. Unknown categories or incomplete breakdowns do not permit a cash fallback.

net_cash_per_share.description: Net cash or debt divided by compatible period-end common shares outstanding. Net cash equals reported cash and short-term investments, less the carrying amount of consolidated borrowings and finance-lease liabilities. Excludes noncurrent investments, restricted balances, operating-lease liabilities, and derivative positions. Positive means net cash per share. Unavailable when a required input is missing or a denominator is zero. Use a compatible common class or class group and the selected filing's stock-split basis. The consolidated numerator is not allocated solely to common shareholders and does not represent distributable cash. Unavailable if the common-share basis is unproven or the share denominator is nonpositive. The liquidity amount uses reported cash and separately identifiable unrestricted current investment categories. A complete classified current-asset breakdown can establish a cash-only aggregate without establishing zero for an undisclosed standalone investment balance. Unknown categories or incomplete breakdowns do not permit a cash fallback. API presentation uses the latest verified stock-split basis across published annual filings. Original filing values remain retained; per-share metrics use adjusted inputs.

working_capital.description: Total current assets less total current liabilities at the filing period end. Unavailable when a required input is missing.

book_value_per_share.description: Permanent parent equity less the carrying amount attributable to permanent preferred equity, divided by compatible period-end common shares on the selected filing's class and stock-split basis. Temporary equity is already excluded from parent permanent equity and is not subtracted again. This is common carrying book value, not market or liquidation value. Unavailable when an input or compatible share basis is missing or shares are nonpositive. API presentation uses the latest verified stock-split basis across published annual filings. Original filing values remain retained; per-share metrics use adjusted inputs.

tangible_book_value.description: Consolidated permanent equity, including noncontrolling and permanent preferred interests, less consolidated goodwill and other identifiable intangible assets. This is consolidated tangible equity, not tangible common equity attributable solely to parent shareholders. Negative values remain valid. Unavailable when any input is missing. The intangible deduction follows the identifiable-intangible target; do not deduct separately classified content, contract-cost or hosted-service assets solely because they are nonphysical.

current_ratio.description: Total current assets divided by total current liabilities at the filing period end. Unavailable when a required input is missing or current liabilities are nonpositive.

cash_ratio.description: Reported cash and short-term investments divided by current liabilities at period end. Excludes restricted cash. Unavailable when a required input is missing or current liabilities are nonpositive. Current investments are not necessarily cash equivalents or immediately liquid; the formula includes the defined current-investment balance without assuming otherwise. The liquidity amount uses reported cash and separately identifiable unrestricted current investment categories. A complete classified current-asset breakdown can establish a cash-only aggregate without establishing zero for an undisclosed standalone investment balance. Unknown categories or incomplete breakdowns do not permit a cash fallback.

quick_ratio.description: Reported cash and short-term investments and current accounts receivable on the filing's reported-category basis divided by total current liabilities at the filing period end. Includes noncustomer balances embedded in the main reported accounts-receivable category; excludes separately classified other receivables, restricted cash, inventory, contract assets and noncurrent assets. Unavailable when a required input is missing or current liabilities are nonpositive. Current investments are not necessarily cash equivalents or immediately liquid; the formula includes the defined current-investment balance without assuming otherwise. The liquidity amount uses reported cash and separately identifiable unrestricted current investment categories. A complete classified current-asset breakdown can establish a cash-only aggregate without establishing zero for an undisclosed standalone investment balance. Unknown categories or incomplete breakdowns do not permit a cash fallback.

debt_to_assets.description: Total debt, including finance lease liabilities but excluding operating lease liabilities, divided by consolidated total assets at the filing period end. Unavailable when a required input is missing or total assets are nonpositive.

debt_to_parent_equity.description: Total debt, including finance lease liabilities but excluding operating lease liabilities, divided by permanent equity attributable to the parent at the same reporting date. Parent equity includes preferred equity and excludes noncontrolling interests and temporary equity. Unavailable when a required input is missing or parent equity is nonpositive.

free_cash_flow.description: Consolidated net cash from operating activities less reported investing capital expenditure, including separately reported software and productive intangible payments. Preserve the capex/acquisition boundary: do not subtract embedded assets in a retained combined acquisition category again. Excludes financing cash flows such as finance-lease principal from capex. Operating cash flow includes discontinued operations when included in the filed subtotal. Unavailable when a required input is missing. Capex retains its disclosed gross or net-of-disposal basis; do not subtract embedded disposal proceeds twice.

free_cash_flow_margin.description: Free cash flow, calculated as consolidated operating cash flow less productive-asset capital expenditure, divided by consolidated continuing-operations revenue for the same annual period. Unavailable when a required input is missing or revenue is nonpositive. The numerator includes all operations while revenue excludes discontinued operations; this stated convention is not a continuing-operations cash-flow margin and does not switch across issuers.

free_cash_flow_per_share.description: Operating cash flow less reported productive-asset capital expenditure, divided by weighted-average diluted shares for the same annual period. Capital expenditure uses positive spending amounts. Unavailable when a required input is missing or a denominator is zero. Use a compatible common class or class group and the selected filing's stock-split basis. The consolidated numerator is not allocated solely to common shareholders and does not represent distributable cash. Unavailable if the common-share basis is unproven or the share denominator is nonpositive. Capital expenditure retains an explicitly reported net-of-disposal basis when gross purchases are unavailable; do not subtract embedded disposal proceeds twice. API presentation uses the latest verified stock-split basis across published annual filings. Original filing values remain retained; per-share metrics use adjusted inputs.

operating_cash_flow_margin.description: Consolidated net cash from operating activities, including discontinued operations when included in the filed subtotal, divided by consolidated continuing-operations revenue for the same annual period. Unavailable when a required input is missing or revenue is nonpositive. The numerator includes all operations while revenue excludes discontinued operations; this stated convention is not a continuing-operations cash-flow margin and does not switch across issuers.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.description: Consolidated operating cash flow divided by consolidated income-statement net income including noncontrolling interests, with both amounts including continuing and discontinued operations for the same period. Do not use an arbitrary parent-only or variable-scope cash-flow reconciliation starting amount. Unavailable when any input is missing or net income is nonpositive. Uses the income targets' reported-basis convention for explicitly immaterial, unquantified NCI allocations embedded in earnings; separately quantified NCI remains included. This does not assume zero NCI income.

capital_expenditure_to_revenue.description: Reported cash productive-asset capital expenditure divided by consolidated continuing-operations revenue for the same annual period. Capital expenditure follows the investing cash-flow target and can include discontinued operations; it excludes noncash financed acquisitions. Unavailable when an input is missing or revenue is nonpositive. Capital expenditure retains an explicitly reported net-of-disposal basis when gross purchases are unavailable; do not subtract embedded disposal proceeds twice.

debt_to_ebitda.description: Period-end total debt, including finance leases and excluding operating leases, divided by full-year EBITDA from consolidated continuing operations. Unavailable when an input is missing or EBITDA is nonpositive. This fixed analytical ratio is not issuer covenant leverage. Uses the income targets' reported-basis convention for explicitly immaterial, unquantified NCI allocations embedded in earnings; separately quantified NCI remains included. This does not assume zero NCI income.

net_debt_to_ebitda.description: Period-end carrying amount of consolidated borrowings and finance-lease liabilities less reported cash and short-term investments, divided by full-year EBITDA from consolidated continuing operations. Excludes noncurrent investments, restricted balances, operating-lease liabilities, and derivative positions from net debt. Negative net debt denotes net cash and can produce a negative ratio. Unavailable when an input is missing or EBITDA is nonpositive. This is not issuer covenant leverage. The liquidity amount uses reported cash and separately identifiable unrestricted current investment categories. A complete classified current-asset breakdown can establish a cash-only aggregate without establishing zero for an undisclosed standalone investment balance. Unknown categories or incomplete breakdowns do not permit a cash fallback. Uses the income targets' reported-basis convention for explicitly immaterial, unquantified NCI allocations embedded in earnings; separately quantified NCI remains included. This does not assume zero NCI income.
